Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE isolated sown growth stage for CABBAGE in the existing medieval isometric farming game.
Four tiny spherical dark-brown cabbage seeds, half embedded in four tiny separate soil pinches arranged as a clean flat 2:1 isometric diamond. This is immediately after sowing: NO leaves or shoots. A small lower-centered group, with transparent space between all four pinches. No seed packet, loose lettuce seed shapes, soil tile or raised platform.
Match reference image's crisp detailed pixel-art clusters, muted green palette, warm cream leaf veins, dark green outlines and light from upper left. Reference image is harvested cabbage identity/style only; follow the requested plant growth stage instead of copying its maturity. Strict 2:1 dimetric camera, readable at 32 pixels, discrete pixel highlights, no smooth shading or blur. Square 1254x1254 PNG with genuine transparent alpha. Keep the whole subject fully visible with ample transparent padding, bottom ground-contact point about (627,1160). The seed diamond sits in the lower half of the canvas, roughly 700px wide and 350px high.
No ground tile, surrounding grass, thick soil base, planter, garden bed, cast shadow, unrelated objects, additional growth stages, sprite sheet, labels, text, logo, watermark, opaque background or painted checkerboard. Everything outside the subject is transparent.
